name: RaceIQ MotoGP
summary: Sprint, Grand Prix, and championship forecasts for the premier MotoGP world championship.
description: The premier-class motorcycle series on the MotorsportVerse core. A leakage-safe rider-skill blend (cross-season Elo with rookie pooling + finishing history + a first-class manufacturer/bike term — MotoGP is not a spec series) routed through two race heads that share the qualifying grid: the Saturday Sprint (shorter, higher-variance) and Sunday's Grand Prix, with Monte Carlo win/podium probabilities, finishing-range intervals, and a Sprint+GP-aware rider championship projection. Runs on the real 2026 MotoGP season pulled from the official results API into a committed, reviewable snapshot (2021-2026 corpus). The post-qualifying forecast is the headline surface and is validated to beat the grid-order baseline on win- and podium-Brier; forward-eval grades every completed round honestly against grid and last-standings baselines. Deployed site + scheduled refresh pipeline.
datasets: api.motogp.pulselive.com (official results API, pulled to a committed snapshot)
